title: Static Radiating-Fan Deep-Body Lionfish
description: One complete stylised lionfish-like exterior with a short deep laterally compressed head/body, narrow tailstock and rounded vertical fan tail. Two very broad nonplanar scalloped pectoral fans radiate from actual body roots, with a tall comb-like finite dorsal fin, paired lower fins and rear anal fin. Broad fin silhouette and head/trunk proportions are newly authored together rather than old fish plus more spines or stripe recoloring; no old geometry arrays reused. Four opaque matte roles, one model zero scenes. Static artistic exterior only: no exact species, anatomical ray counts, gills, venom, handling, swimming, rig, animation, interaction or safety claims.
